name: How-to: typewriter titles + numbered steps
best_for: 'How I do X' tutorials and numbered tip lists (64-82 s): walkthroughs, screen-recording demos, growth tips.
notes: Typewriter at ~40 chars/s on per-line sharp-cornered highlight boxes: pale yellow for the hook, pale pink for numbered section titles ('01. credibility hook'). Handwritten sub-lines. Proof devices: white document cards, label boxes, staggered label pairs, phone/editor inset. Captions in a fixed centred lane y~55-60%; they sit over cards, so the engine flips them to dark on light cards. v12 uses a slow 100->120% push-in.
